description: Connects your website to VICTOR ANALYTICS: your domain points at our reverse proxy, which forwards every visit to your existing website unchanged and adds the one-line analytics script to your pages. Visitors, leads (calls, WhatsApp, email, forms) and traffic sources appear in your dashboard. Nothing else on your site or email changes.
variableDescription: siteKey = the public key that identifies the customer's website in VICTOR ANALYTICS; it is written to the _victor TXT record only to prove that the customer approved this domain.
